About.title: About VinTech
About.description: VinTech AS delivers high quality software solutions tailored to your business needs.

approach.title: Approach
approach.content: While I am passionate about technology and strive try to stay on top of the latest trends, I believe in an approach where the business objective is the main focus. I work closely with clients to understand their unique challenges and goals, ensuring that the solutions I provide are not only technically sound, but also aligned with the goals and objectives of the business.

values.title: Values
values.content: Ownership, transparency and adaptiveness are the core values that guide my work. I take ownership of my work and am transparent about the process, challenges, and progress. I believe in being adaptable to changing requirements and feedback, ensuring that the solutions I provide are flexible and can evolve with the needs of the business.

expertise.title: Expertise
expertise.content: While my main interest and expertise lies in backend, cloud development and software infrastructure, I have extensive experience in a wide range of technologies, frameworks and methodologies spanning all aspects of the software development lifecycle. Languages, frameworks, and tools include but are not limited to TypeScript, React, Python, Java, Kotlin, AWS, Azure and Terraform. Do not hesitate to contact for a more complete resume!

Services.title: Services
Services.description: Areas where I can help you

development.title: Full-Stack Development
development.description: Custom web applications, responsive websites, and real-time systems designed and built with modern technologies and best practices.

cloud.title: Cloud Development & Migration
cloud.description: Development of cloud-based solutions, seamless migration from on-premises to cloud, and optimization of cloud resources for better performance and reduced costs.

strategy.title: IT Strategy & Workflows
strategy.description: Development of comprehensive IT strategies, implementation of efficient developer workflows, and establishment of modern DevOps practices.

machineLearning.title: Machine Learning & AI
machineLearning.description: Implementation of machine learning models and AI solutions to optimize processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation.

Contact.title: Get in Touch
Contact.description: Ready to discuss your IT needs? Contact me today for a consultation.

CookieBanner.title: Cookie Preferences
CookieBanner.description: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and personalize content. By clicking 'Accept all', you consent to our use of cookies.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy explains how VinTech AS ('we', 'us', or 'our') collects, uses, and shares your personal information when you visit our website or contact us through our forms. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We collect different types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our services to you.

contactForm.title: Contact Form Information
contactForm.content: When you submit a contact form, we collect the following information:

analytics.title: Usage and Analytics Data
analytics.content: We use analytics services to help us understand how our website is being used. This data includes:

items.duration: Time spent on the website and pages visited

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUse.content: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

items.communication: To respond to your inquiries and contact you regarding services
items.improvement: To improve our website and services based on your feedback and interactions
items.analytics: To analyze usage patterns and optimize user experience

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Service Providers
thirdParties.intro: We use the following third-party services to help operate our website and provide our services:

vercel.title: Vercel (Hosting, Analytics & Speed Insights)
vercel.content: We use Vercel to host our website and collect analytics data about how our website performs. Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights help us understand performance metrics and usage patterns.

google.title: Google Analytics (via Google Tag Manager)
google.content: We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors interact with our website. This service uses cookies to collect information about your device, browser, IP address (anonymized), and browsing behavior.

resend.title: Resend (Email Service)
resend.content: We use Resend to process and deliver emails sent through our contact form. When you submit a form, your information is transmitted to Resend's servers for email delivery.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect and track information about your browsing activities. Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device. We use the following types of cookies:

items.necessary: Essential cookies: Required for the website to function properly
items.analytics: Analytics cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website (you can opt out of these)

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content: Under GDPR and Norwegian privacy law, you have several rights regarding your personal data, including:

items.access: The right to access your personal information
items.rectification: The right to request correction of inaccurate information
items.erasure: The right to request deletion of your information
items.restriction: The right to restrict processing of your information
items.objection: The right to object to processing of your information

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: We will retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy. Contact form submissions are typically retained for up to 12 months, unless you request earlier deletion or we have an ongoing business relationship.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the 'Last Updated' date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us.
